meta.tagline: Component sourcing, brand supply and BOM kitting
meta.defaultDescription: Electronic components and chip trading, brand supply, sourcing and BOM kitting. Send a part list or BOM and we confirm availability line by line.

home.title: From components, to reliable delivery.
home.subtitle: Component and chip sourcing, brand supply and BOM kitting.
home.heroNote: Sourcing range is not stock. Availability and date codes are confirmed line by line before quoting.
home.brandsTitle: Source by brand, price by batch.
home.brandsBody: Analogue and amplifiers, power management, MCUs, memory, interface, RF, connectors and passives. Send the part numbers and quantities; we confirm availability and date codes line by line before quoting.
home.brandsNote: Brand names describe the sourcing range only. They do not imply manufacturer authorisation or partnership.
home.companyTitle: One thread from inquiry to delivery.
home.companyBody: Sales, purchasing, quality and warehouse work from the same inquiry record. Who received it, who priced it, who inspected it and who shipped it stays traceable to a person and a timestamp.
home.warehouseTitle: Receive, label, verify, ship. Each step leaves a record.
home.warehouseBody: Our own storage conditions, third-party partners and the documents we can hand over are listed item by item on the warehouse and quality page.
home.flowTitle: A precise request beats a lowball price.
home.flowBody: Full part number, package, quantity and target date code decide whether we can quote accurately the first time.
home.ctaBody: One part requirement or a BOM file, plus one working contact channel. Inquiries are handled in the order they arrive.
home.categoriesBody: Every category below accepts a sourcing request. One request can mix categories, or you can upload a BOM and we will break it down.
home.limitsBody: There is no checkout on this site: procurement prices each line, then returns a quote with alternatives. Orders run on quotation and contract.
home.teamBody: Every request is followed by three functions: procurement prices the lines and finds alternatives, quality inspects incoming and outgoing goods, logistics handles batches and lead times.

brands.title: Brand index
brands.lead: The brands below accept sourcing requests. Selecting one carries the name into your request so we can price by brand.
brands.searchPlaceholder: Brand name, e.g. TI, ST, NXP
brands.empty: No brand matched. You can still submit an inquiry with the brand and part number you need.
brands.note: Brand names are trademarks of their respective owners.
brands.askAnyCta: Send the brand and part number in an inquiry

capabilities.title: From one part number to a full BOM.
capabilities.lead: Our job is turning a loose requirement into a quotable line: confirm the part, confirm availability, confirm the date code, then discuss price and lead time.
capabilities.categoriesTitle: Organised by request, not by empty product pages.
capabilities.categoriesBody: Every category here accepts a sourcing request. Stock and price are confirmed per batch, so no generic price list is posted.
capabilities.limitsBody: No online payment, cart or customer account: price, stock and lead time are confirmed per order, and every deal runs on a quotation and a contract.

quality.title: Verifiable is what reliable means.
quality.lead: Receiving, labelling, checking and dispatch all run through our own process. Batches that need third-party testing ship with the report attached.
quality.documentsBody: Inspection reports, manufacturer or supplier accompanying documents, packaging and label photos can be provided for a specific date code. Tell us which documents you need in the inquiry.
quality.imageNote: Illustration, not a photo of our warehouse.

about.title: A trading team that confirms before it promises.
about.lead: We trade electronic components and chips, supply brands, source parts and kit BOMs. We do not invent stock and we do not promise an unconfirmed lead time.
about.storyBody: When a request arrives, purchasing confirms the part number and package, then checks availability and date code with the relevant channel. Quality reviews markings and appearance where needed. The warehouse picks, verifies, packs and ships. Every step is recorded, so a problem can be traced to a step rather than blamed on a person.
about.teamBody: The team is split across sourcing, quality, warehouse and customer service. Each line owns one part of the process, and the person handling your inquiry is named in the reply.
about.valuesTitle: A few things we hold to

values.title: Confirm, then quote
values.body: No price is issued before part number, package, date code and availability are confirmed.

values.title: State only what is true
values.body: Authorisation and certification are stated only where documents exist. What we cannot show, we do not print.

values.title: Leave a trail
values.body: Inquiry, pricing, inspection and shipment records are reviewable, so issues are located in the process, not in a person.

contact.title: Tell us the requirement, or ask a question first.
contact.lead: For quotations please use the inquiry form so the request gets a reference and enters the queue. The channels below are for general contact.
contact.formNote: This form is for general questions. Part lists and BOMs should go through the inquiry form.
contact.responseNote: Requests sent during working hours are usually answered the next business day. Actual turnaround depends on the requirement.
contact.pendingNote: Contact details are being updated. For urgent requirements, submit a request and we will reply as soon as it is reviewed.

inquiry.title: Request a quote
inquiry.lead: At least one part requirement or a BOM file, plus one working contact channel. Fields marked * are required.
inquiry.itemsHint: One part per line. Keep the part number exactly as written; do not rewrite suffixes.
inquiry.uploadHint: PDF, CSV, XLS, XLSX, TXT, PNG, JPG. Up to 8MB each, 3 files maximum. Files are used for this inquiry only and are never placed in a public directory.
inquiry.uploadDrop: Drop files here, or click to choose
inquiry.messagePlaceholder: Lead time, target price, substitutes accepted, documents needed
inquiry.consent: I agree that this submission is processed under the privacy policy.
inquiry.successBody: The record has been saved. Keep the reference below and quote it in follow-ups.
inquiry.duplicateNotice: This submission matched a recent record, so the same reference was returned.
inquiry.errorBody: Your input is still on the page. Check the marked fields and retry. If it keeps failing, tell us through the contact page.
inquiry.serverError: The server could not save this request. Please retry shortly.
inquiry.rateLimited: Too many submissions. Please try again later.

errors.items_required: Add at least one part number, or upload a BOM file.
errors.contact_required: Leave at least an email address or a phone number.
errors.phone_invalid: That phone number looks invalid. Include the country code.
errors.qty_invalid: Quantity must be a positive whole number.
errors.file_type: This file type is not supported.
errors.consent_required: Please accept the privacy policy first.

inquiry.staticNotice: This copy is a static build hosted on GitHub Pages. There is no server behind it: the form still validates as you type, but submitting sends nothing, stores nothing and returns no inquiry code. Use the Node deployment for real requests.

footer.blurb: Component and chip trading, brand supply, sourcing and BOM kitting.
footer.noFakeContact: Contact details are not published yet. Send an inquiry and we will reply from a real address.

legal.privacyLead: This page explains what we collect during an inquiry, why, and how it is stored.

privacySections.title: What we collect
privacySections.body: Company, name, email, phone, country or region, part list, requirement notes and any BOM or attachment you choose to upload. Technically we also record submission time, language and a hashed IP used for rate limiting.

privacySections.title: Why
privacySections.body: To process the inquiry, reply, follow up internally and keep the records required for the business. Your data is not used for unrelated marketing unless you explicitly opt in.

privacySections.title: Storage and access
privacySections.body: Inquiry records live in a controlled database. Attachments are stored outside the public directory and can only be downloaded by authorised staff signed into the admin console, with a server-side permission check on every download.

privacySections.title: Retention
privacySections.body: Retention follows actual business and contractual requirements. You may ask us to access, correct or delete a submitted record through the contact page.

privacySections.title: Third parties
privacySections.body: We do not sell or rent your information. Logistics, payment or inspection partners receive only what is necessary to complete a delivery. Notification email is sent through the configured mail service.

legal.termsLead: Basic rules for using this site and submitting an inquiry.

termsSections.title: Information only
termsSections.body: Brands, categories and part information describe a sourcing range. They are not a commitment on stock, price, lead time or authorisation. All transaction terms follow the quotation or contract both sides confirm.

termsSections.title: Inquiry and reply
termsSections.body: Submitting an inquiry creates no contractual obligation. We reply after confirming availability line by line and state clearly when a part cannot be supplied.

termsSections.title: Brands and trademarks
termsSections.body: Brand names and marks belong to their owners. They identify a sourcing range only and do not imply official authorisation, distributorship or partnership.

termsSections.title: Attachments
termsSections.body: Upload only material you have the right to provide. Do not upload malicious code or content that infringes third-party rights.

termsSections.title: Liability
termsSections.body: To the extent permitted by law, this site is not liable for purchasing decisions made from information published here. Specific liability follows the contract.

faqPage.lead: Sourcing, quoting, delivery and documents. If your question is not covered, submit an inquiry or leave a message on the contact page.
